plugins.name: gt-workflow
plugins.description: Graphite-native workflow skills for stacked PR development — commit auditing, stack planning, sync, and navigation, invoked as Codex skills through the gt CLI.

plugins.name: yellow-core
plugins.description: Four read-only skills: agent-native architecture and audit references, plan-status dashboard, and existing-worktree inventory. Excludes commands, agents, hooks and all other skills.

plugins.name: yellow-cursor
plugins.description: Cursor Cloud Agents integration — delegate coding tasks to Cursor's remote agents, track status, and manage runs

plugins.name: yellow-jules
plugins.description: Two read-only reference skills — the Jules delegation lifecycle and CLI contract, and the one-pass supervision loop. Writes always need a grant the owner creates on a terminal. Excludes all of yellow-jules' commands.

plugins.name: yellow-review
plugins.description: One read-only skill: the thermonuclear structural-quality review rubric — code-judo restructurings, spaghetti-condition growth, weak type and module boundaries, misplaced ownership, and evidence-gated file-size threshold crossings (when the requester supplies before/after line counts). Invoke it explicitly by name; it is not applied to ordinary reviews automatically. Reports findings only; never edits the repository. Excludes all of yellow-review's commands, agents, and other skills.

plugins.name: yellow-debt
plugins.description: One bounded read-only debt-complexity-scan workflow. Other commands, agents, skills and hooks remain excluded.

plugins.name: yellow-ci
plugins.description: CI failure diagnosis, GitHub Actions workflow linting, self-hosted runner setup and health skills, invoked as Codex skills. Read-mostly: SSH/config writes and workflow-lint fixes always preview and confirm first.

plugins.name: yellow-research
plugins.description: One bounded read-only research-public-repo workflow. Other commands, agents, skills and hooks remain excluded.

plugins.name: yellow-docs
plugins.description: One bounded read-only docs-audit workflow. Other commands, agents, skills and hooks remain excluded.

plugins.name: yellow-codex
plugins.description: OpenAI Codex CLI wrapper with review, rescue, and analysis agents for workflow integration
